title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: Creative Director

We're a remote-first crew across the US and Buenos Aires. We care about bold, ground breaking work, and about the people who make it.

This is more than a creative leadership role. You'll lead the people, the capacity, and the way we work: our two full-time creatives, our freelance bench, and the process that gets great work out the door. You'll partner with our delivery team on priorities, and set the vision and standards for the department.
  
  
You'll stay hands-on too, leading brand, campaign, web, and pitch work.
  
  
And you'll help shape how AI fits into our creative work. That means testing tools, deciding where and when they belong, and making sure they improve both the quality of what we make and the team's experience making it.
  
  
This is a senior role for someone with a proven track record leading creative in a fast-paced agency.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Lead the department.**

* Manage, mentor, and grow our two full-time creatives. Clear goals, honest feedback, real development.
* Set the creative vision and the way we work, then champion it across the agency.
* Build a team people want to be on, and a culture where the bar keeps rising.
* Bring the creative point of view to leadership conversations about where JumpSeat goes next.

**Run the engine.**

* Own capacity planning. Anticipate resourcing needs proactively and balance the load across the team.
* Know when we need more hands. Find, brief, and manage freelancers who meet our bar and our budget.
* Partner with the delivery team to set priorities, timelines, and scope.
* Keep sharpening the creative workflow, from brief to review to client handoff.
* Be the single point of contact for every creative deliverable. On brand, on time, every time.

**Raise the creative bar.**

* Own the quality of everything we make, across every client and channel.
* Lead brand development work: positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
* Concept and lead campaigns, ABM programs, and digital advertising.
* Oversee website design and development.
* Give clear, useful direction to designers and copywriters.
* Work closely with our strategy and account teams so creative work serves each client's business goals.
* Lead the creative side of new business pitches, from concept to presentation.

**Shape How We Use AI.**

* Experiment with AI tools across ideation, copy, design, and production.
* Decide where, when, and how AI tools and workflows are adopted in our day-to-day, based on one test: does it make the work better, and the work of making it better?
* Set practical guardrails for quality, brand fit, and client trust.
* Help the team build skill and confidence with new tools, and share what works across JumpSeat.

**Who You Are**

* A Creative Director, ACD, or Head of Creative from a strong agency, who has led a creative team directly.
* A department builder, not just a project lead. You've owned capacity, resourcing, and process, and you actually enjoy it.
* A true partner to delivery and account teams. Comfortable trading off priorities, scope, and timelines in the open.
* Experienced at bringing in and leading freelance talent.
* A versatile creative across branding, web, campaigns, and digital advertising, who still wants to roll up their sleeves.
* Quick to understand the unique aspects of a client's industry, culture and voice, so you can hit the ground running.
* Someone who loves growing people, and builds teams that stick together.
* Hands-on with AI tools, and clear-eyed about them. You already use them in your creative work, and you have a point of view on where they help and where they get in the way.
* A clear, confident presenter with existing and new clients.

**Nice to have**

* Fluent in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite. Other design tools are a plus.
* B2B experience. Helpful, not required.
* You've led a team through a change in tools or workflows before.

**How We'll Get To Know You**

* A conversation with our Talent team.
* A practical case. You'll present how you'd approach a real-world challenge.
* A conversation with senior team members.

**What's In It For You**

* Real influence. You'll shape a function at the core of our business, and how it works.
* Great people. A team that will challenge you, inspire you, and have your back.
* Remote first. Colleagues across the US and Buenos Aires.
* Balance, for real. Unlimited PTO, Summer Fridays, time off between holidays, and more.

**Ready to take the seat?**
If you want to build a creative department, not just fill its pipeline, we want to hear from you.

title: Art Director
description:
**Say hello to Hagerty**  
Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do, and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!  
  
As an **Art Director,** you’ll contribute to Hagerty’s creative output by developing design and concepts that bring the Hagerty brand to life across digital, print, video and event marketing. You’ll collaborate closely with Creative Directors, writers, strategists, and other team members to develop integrated campaigns and presentation decks for business and marketing need. Working as part of a cross-functional creative team, you’ll produce work that is compositionally strong, conceptually driven, and true to our brand’s distinct voice and visual identity. You’re detail-oriented, curious, and eager to grow your craft while contributing to projects that span the full breadth of Hagerty’s creative work.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
***Creative Concept Development***

* Work with Creative Directors and cross-functional teams to build presentation decks for business and marketing needs.
* Develop concepts and campaign ideas for integrated brand and marketing campaigns across channels, including large-scale events and key business initiatives.
* Take campaign platform ideas and develop them into strong, channel-specific creative executions while maintain brand guidelines.
* Produce work that reflects Hagerty’s visual identity and brand voice, including the brand’s signature “twinkle in the eye.”
* Contribute to brainstorming sessions and concept exploration for assigned projects through research and creative development.
* Deliver work on time and communicate with project leaders when timelines are at risk.
* Seek and incorporate feedback from creative leadership with a growth mindset.
* Navigate day-to-day creative challenges by following established processes, seeking guidance from peers and senior team members when unfamiliar situations arise.

***Design Execution***

* Create compositionally strong, thoughtful design work across digital and print mediums using Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma).
* Apply an understanding of graphic design principles including layout, typography, color, and hierarchy to produce effective visual communications.
* Maintain consistency with brand standards and contribute to assigned projects with direction from the Art Director or Creative Director.
* Assist with photo shoot preparation, including contributing to shot lists and asset needs under direction.
* Support pre-flighting and print production processes as needed.

***Collaboration & Brand Stewardship***

* Collaborate with clients, creative leadership, and project teams to understand business objectives and develop appropriate creative solutions.
* Regularly interact with internal clients and stakeholders to ensure work aligns with project goals.
* Stay current on industry trends, popular culture, and emerging advertising techniques; share relevant insights with the team.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment that encourages creative problem-solving and continuous learning.
* Always keep the member’s point of view in mind when creating, ensuring work resonates with Hagerty’s audience.

**This might describe you**

* A plus if you love cars, the automotive world and are an enthusiast yourself.
* You have experience in an advertising agency or strong in-house creative department, concepting, writing, and producing integrated brand and retail campaigns.
* You can easily build presentation decks in programs like Figma, Keynote, or Power Point.
* Foundational knowledge of art direction and graphic design principles.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Figma.
* Understanding of brand visual identity guidelines and brand voice.
* Ability to follow creative direction and incorporate feedback effectively.
* Although you’re an art director, you enjoy throwing out headlines and taglines too.
* Self-motivated with strong organizational habits and attention to detail.
* Collaborative team player who communicates well with cross-functional teams.
* You’re curious about culture, advertising trends, emerging technologies, and new ways to tell stories.
* You enjoy solving creative problems and finding unexpected ways to make an idea more compelling.

**Requirements**

* A portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, art direction, and integrated advertising campaigns.
* Bachelor’s degree in Communication Design, Graphic Design, or a related field, or 3+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and collaboration tools such as Slack.

**Over and above**

* Experience or coursework in both visual design and copywriting disciplines.
* Exposure to print production, pre-flighting processes, or photo shoot support.

**Other things to note**

* This role can be worked from any U.S. remote location.
* Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

If you reside in the following jurisdictions: Illinois, Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Maryland, Minnesota, Nevada, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey, Cincinnati or Toledo, Ohio, Rhode Island, Washington, British Columbia, Canada please email recruiting@hagerty.com for compensation, comprehensive benefits and the perks that set us apart.  
  
At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference. We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

title: Freelance Social & Digital Art Director
description:
New Opportunity! Woven Health Collective is a healthcare marketing, strategy, and science communications company, dedicated to revolutionizing healthcare through innovative solutions and collaborative partnerships. Our unwavering commitment to empathy and collaboration ensures that both our team and clients experience a rewarding journey, where innovation not only advances healthcare but also enriches lives.

At Woven Health Collective, you will be empowered to bring your authentic self to work and unlock your full potential. Come join our growing team!

***Approximately 3-month contract, with an option to renew***

We are seeking a **Freelance Social & Digital Art Director** with pharmaceutical promotional agency experience and a portfolio that demonstrates strong social-first and digital-first design. This is a hands-on creative role for an art director who understands how content is experienced across feeds, paid placements, stories, carousels, short-form video, and broader digital environments.

This is not a traditional, print-first Art Director position. The right candidate is a strong conceptual partner and highly skilled designer who can create work that is visually immediate, platform-appropriate, flexible across formats, and built for the realities of regulated pharmaceutical communications.

**Job Summary**

The Social & Digital Art Director will concept, design, and direct visual content for pharmaceutical brands across social and digital channels. You will partner closely with copywriters, strategists, account teams, and production specialists to create visually compelling, strategically grounded, and medically compliant work from initial concept through final delivery.

You should be comfortable developing both individual social assets and scalable content systems that can support multiple platforms, placements, audience needs, and campaign phases. This role requires strong design craft, a current understanding of social behavior and digital formats, and the ability to translate complex brand and clinical information into clear, engaging visual storytelling.

**Job Responsibilities and Skills**

* Concept and design social-first and digital-first creative for pharmaceutical brands.

* Develop visual systems and polished assets for organic social, paid social, carousels, stories, reels, short-form video, motion content, display, web, and other digital formats.

* Partner with copywriters to develop integrated ideas in which visual storytelling and messaging work together across platforms.

* Translate brand strategy, campaign objectives, and complex clinical information into clear, engaging, consumer-appropriate visual communications.

* Create visual territories, mood boards, storyboards, social-content frameworks, design explorations, and presentation materials.

* Adapt creative work across platform specifications, placements, audience segments, and campaign phases while maintaining creative quality and brand consistency.

* Design with pharmaceutical promotional requirements in mind, including fair balance, required safety information, claims support, reference considerations, and annotation needs.

* Collaborate with motion designers, editors, illustrators, photographers, retouchers, and other production partners to ensure quality from concept through final delivery.

* Maintain a high standard of typography, layout, composition, color, imagery, accessibility, and brand consistency.

* Participate in creative reviews and present work clearly and persuasively to internal teams and clients.

* Stay current on social and digital design behaviors, emerging content formats, platform conventions, and visual trends.

* Manage multiple projects, revisions, and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communications, fine arts, or a related discipline—or equivalent professional experience.

* 5+ years of art direction and design experience, including experience at a pharmaceutical promotional or healthcare advertising agency.

* Pharmaceutical promotional agency experience is required.

* Demonstrated experience designing social content and digital creative for pharmaceutical brands is required.

* A portfolio featuring strong examples of social-first and digital-first work, including paid social, organic social, short-form video or motion, responsive design systems, and platform-specific creative executions.

* Strong conceptual thinking combined with excellent hands-on design and execution skills.

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign; Figma proficiency is strongly preferred.

* Experience collaborating with or directing motion designers, editors, illustrators, photographers, retouchers, and other production partners.

* Experience working within pharmaceutical medical, legal, and regulatory review processes; annotation and Veeva-submission experience is a plus.

* Strong communication, collaboration, presentation, organization, and time-management skills.

* Ability to work independently, respond constructively to feedback, and balance creative ambition with accuracy, compliance, and production realities.

**Portfolio requirement:** Applicants must submit a portfolio with clear examples of pharmaceutical social and digital design. Traditional print, detail aid, or general brand work alone is not sufficient.

**Disclaimer**

*Woven Health Collective* *provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

title: Associate Design Director
description:
**WHO WE ARE**

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well-known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

  

**WHAT’S AN ASSOCIATE DESIGN DIRECTOR AT HOOK?**

Hook is seeking a hands-on Associate Design Director to join one of our teams.

Associate Design Directors are experienced leaders who use design to exceed client goals, while working within the guard rails of existing brand marketing strategies. They operate alongside creative and motion teams, serving as a client-facing bridge between high-level brand strategy and systematic visual execution. They create robust visual languages and scalable design frameworks that power industry-leading content across static and animated mediums.

They are driven experts with a passion for making premium, ground-breaking work and a commitment to fostering the talents of the employees they collaborate with. They are fearless executors who elevate the work into new creative territories. They’re fundamentalists when it comes to digital design, but approach projects with rational and innovative mindsets, always mindful of how it looks and how it works.

Associate Design Directors are ready for hands-on projects at every stage of the life cycle, from brainstorming creative concepts with the project team and developing original campaigns, to participating in client presentations and ensuring deadlines are met, to building dynamic design systems and overseeing high-volume production rollouts that scale seamlessly across digital, video, print, and emerging platforms.

They have a well-established process for concept development, using visual presentations, storyboards, and mocks to communicate solutions to peers, leadership, and clients. They also excel at translating bold concepts into modular, extensible design systems. With expertise in design tokenization, asset automation, and end-to-end production pipelines, they ensure pixel-perfect, efficient client delivery at scale, always on time and on spec.

While this role would oversee tactical production workstreams, their responsibilities will also focus on strategic and conceptual visual design challenges for national and global brands/campaigns. With an existing design team in place, and opportunities to recruit additional talent, previous experience with team and project leadership within a rapid production environment will be a critical skill. Given the close proximity to marketing clients, being an excellent communicator and an overall joy-to-work-with will also go a long way toward success.

While this role can work from any approved location, this person must have the flexibility to work around PST hours as the team’s clients are based on the West Coast.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

* Demonstrate a mastery of visual design across design disciplines
* Execute, manage, and govern original, conceptual, and system-driven visual design work in line with agency standards and complex brand design systems
* Build and maintain comprehensive visual design systems, component libraries, and modular toolkits that empower teams to produce high-volume assets efficiently without losing creative fidelity
* Apply design rigor to provide mentorship to cross-functional teams with the goal of accelerating skill progression
* Inspire, oversee, and provide mentorship to design staff with the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration, experimentation, and knowledge sharing
* Fluently speak the language of design with both clients and creatives enabling effective feedback and direction
* Demonstrate emotional intelligence in all meetings and communications
* Work closely with creative staff to ensure design work goes above and beyond the expected
* Maintain and promote internal best practices around modern production design, tool integrations, automated workflows, and standardized asset handoffs
* Model a sense of ownership that elevates the standards and quality of all work achieved by the designers
* Demonstrate an ability to work on multiple projects at the same time while maintaining clear vision of priorities
* Lead projects and oversee a team to ensure that work is client-ready at all phases of their projects
* Manage direct reports to help shape and grow their careers as it relates to their hard and soft skill development

  

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

* Demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship in design, with expertise working on design solutions as it relates to campaigns and visual systems across multiple platforms
* Expertise in visual design with a deep focus on design systems, component architecture, and multi-channel campaign scaling
* Proven experience leading design streams, multi-format adaptation pipelines, and modular creative rollouts for complex, multi-market campaigns
* Have outstanding communication and presentation skills
* Be imaginative, collaborative, conceptual, and curious
* Have an optimistic outlook toward client revisions, knowing when and how to offer opportunities to push boundaries creatively
* Generate and maintain enthusiasm for ideas within the agency as they move from concept to execution
* Mastery of Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator) alongside a strong technical understanding of digital production formats, asset optimization, and platform specs
* Mastery of Figma (variables, auto-layout, component libraries, dynamic templates) to build scalable design infrastructure and drive workflow efficiencies
* Additional programs and skills are great to come with (illustration, motion/After Effects, 3D/Cinema 4D)
* Have direct experience—and an enthusiasm for—team leadership and mentorship

  

**WHAT ELSE**

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a link to a portfolio/body of work that demonstrates a breadth of experience.

This is a full-time position that can be hybrid or remote, depending on geographic location. We're a close-knit group of people who love what we do and want to create phenomenal work.

Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, wellness stipends/continuing education subsidies and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Creative Director - Paravel Insights
description:
Creative Director - Paravel Insights

**Creative Director**
=====================

**Location:** Remote, U.S. Based
  
**Type:** Full-Time Contract

**About Paravel Insights**
--------------------------

Paravel Insights is a strategy, marketing, and creative agency that exists to empower visionary and faith-based organizations. We partner with mission-driven clients across advocacy, education, nonprofit, political, and cultural spaces to help build meaningful movements and high-impact campaigns.

Our team thrives in fast-moving environments where strategy, creativity, and execution work hand in hand. We value excellence, initiative, adaptability, humility, and strong collaboration.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Paravel Insights is seeking an experienced, strategic, and visionary **Creative Director** to lead our creative department and oversee creative direction, strategy, development, and execution across our client accounts and campaigns.

This is a senior leadership role responsible for guiding the entire creative process, from initial strategy and conceptual development through design, copywriting, storytelling, film and video production, and final execution.

We are looking for someone who can see the big picture while maintaining a strong understanding of the details that make great work successful. The ideal candidate brings a combination of creative vision, strategic thinking, strong leadership, and hands-on expertise.

We need someone who can lead a multidisciplinary team, develop strong campaign concepts, oversee visual and written content as well as film and video, establish clear standards, and ensure everything produced by the department is strategically aligned and executed with excellence.

The right person will be comfortable leading creative conversations, presenting and defending ideas, making decisions, mentoring team members, and taking ownership of the department's performance and output.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Creative Department Leadership & Team Development**

* Lead and oversee Paravel's creative department, including design, copywriting, film and video, and related creative disciplines.
* Serve as the primary day-to-day leader of the department, providing clear direction, support, and accountability.
* Establish and maintain high standards for quality, consistency, collaboration, and execution.
* Provide mentorship, coaching, professional development, and performance feedback to team members.
* Partner with the Design Director to ensure strong visual leadership, effective design execution, and consistency across projects.
* Foster a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment that encourages innovation, initiative, ownership, and excellence.
* Partner with executive leadership on department structure, staffing needs, resource planning, and long-term team development.
* Establish and improve workflows, review processes, and departmental practices that support both quality and efficiency.

### **Creative Vision, Strategy & Direction**

* Lead the development of compelling campaign concepts, brand narratives, messaging approaches, and integrated creative strategies.
* Collaborate closely with strategists and account leads to translate client objectives, audience insights, and campaign strategies into effective creative solutions.
* Oversee concept development from initial brainstorming and strategic planning through final execution.
* Guide the creative direction of campaigns across multiple clients, industries, and platforms.
* Ensure that creative decisions are intentional, strategically grounded, and aligned with client goals.
* Bring fresh perspectives, original ideas, and innovative approaches to campaign development and creative challenges.
* Evaluate concepts and provide clear, constructive feedback that strengthens the work.
* Help identify opportunities to elevate campaigns, improve storytelling, and increase overall impact.
* Contribute to new business opportunities, pitches, presentations, and strategic planning initiatives.

### **Design, Copywriting, Film & Content Oversight**

* Provide leadership and direction across visual design, written content, film, and video, ensuring cohesive creative execution.
* Oversee brand identity development, campaign design, advertising creative, messaging, copywriting, film and video production, content development, and storytelling.
* Ensure that design, copy, and video work together to communicate clear, compelling, and strategically aligned messages.
* Ensure all campaign messaging, copywriting, and written communications reflect natural American English, appropriate cultural context, and the intended tone and voice for U.S. audiences.
* Provide creative direction for video campaigns, television commercials, digital advertising, branded films, and other video content from concept through final production.
* Collaborate with internal production teams, videographers, editors, directors, and external production partners to ensure a cohesive creative vision.
* Guide creative development across digital, print, social media, websites, film, video, advertising, presentations, events, and other campaign channels.
* Review and approve creative concepts, designs, messaging, scripts, storyboards, video treatments, and final deliverables for quality, accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment.
* Work closely with the Design Director to maintain high visual standards while providing overarching direction across the department.
* Lead copywriters in developing effective messaging, headlines, campaign narratives, advertising copy, scripts, and other written communications.
* Maintain a strong understanding of design principles, copywriting, brand strategy, visual storytelling, audience engagement, and multichannel execution.
* Provide hands-on creative guidance and contribute directly to concept development or execution when needed.

### **Campaign Development & Execution**

* Lead the creative development of integrated campaigns and initiatives from initial concept through launch.
* Oversee campaign identities, messaging frameworks, visual systems, content development, and supporting creative assets.
* Ensure a cohesive approach across campaign platforms, channels, and deliverables.
* Guide creative work for brand launches, awareness campaigns, fundraising initiatives, advocacy efforts, recruitment campaigns, advertising, and storytelling experiences.
* Oversee the creative direction of film and video projects, including concept development, scripting, storyboarding, production planning, and post-production review.
* Partner with production teams to ensure commercials and video content align with campaign strategy, messaging, and overall creative vision.
* Balance ambitious ideas with practical considerations, including budgets, timelines, resources, and client expectations.
* Collaborate with project managers and account leads to ensure projects move efficiently from planning to delivery.
* Identify challenges early, provide solutions, and help keep projects moving forward.
* Adapt quickly to changing priorities, evolving strategies, and new client needs.

### **Quality Control, Accountability & Department Performance**

* Take ownership of the overall quality, consistency, and effectiveness of work produced by the department.
* Establish clear review and approval processes to maintain high standards across all deliverables.
* Ensure creative work aligns with approved strategies, client objectives, brand guidelines, and project requirements.
* Provide decisive, constructive feedback and ensure revisions strengthen the final product.
* Work closely with project managers to maintain accountability for deadlines, deliverables, and project milestones.
* Evaluate campaign performance, client feedback, and results to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Identify and implement improvements to creative workflows, team collaboration, and departmental efficiency.
* Maintain a high standard of excellence while empowering team members to take ownership of their responsibilities.

### **Cross-Department Collaboration & Client Leadership**

* **Reporting Structure:** Report directly to the Senior Marketing Strategist (Account Lead) and the Chief Operating Officer (Acting Executive Creative Director).
* **Department Leadership:** Directly oversee and lead the Design Director, designers, and copywriters, while providing creative direction and oversight for film and video production.
* Translate strategic direction from the Senior Marketing Strategist and executive creative direction from the COO into clear, actionable guidance for the creative team.
* Collaborate closely with executive leadership, senior strategists, account managers, project managers, and production teams.
* Serve as a key creative leader in internal planning, campaign development, and strategic discussions.
* Participate in client meetings, presentations, campaign reviews, and creative workshops.
* Present concepts confidently, communicate strategic rationale, and guide discussions with internal teams and clients.
* Build strong working relationships across departments to ensure alignment between strategy, creative development, and execution.
* Help bridge the gap between strategic vision and the practical work required to bring campaigns to life.
* Communicate proactively regarding creative needs, project challenges, priorities, and opportunities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Must be based in the United States and legally authorized to work in the U.S.
* Exceptional written and spoken English proficiency, with native-level fluency, is required.
* 8+ years of professional experience in creative, advertising, marketing, branding, or campaign development, preferably within an agency environment.
* Demonstrated experience leading creative teams, departments, or multidisciplinary creative initiatives.
* Proven ability to oversee design, copywriting, and film and video, with a strong understanding of how these disciplines work together.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative direction, integrated campaign development, brand strategy, advertising, storytelling, and high-quality execution.
* Experience developing and leading campaigns from initial strategy and concept through production and launch.
* Experience providing creative direction for film, video production, television commercials, digital advertising, or branded video content.
* Strong understanding of visual storytelling, scripting, production workflows, editing, and post-production, with the ability to guide specialized production teams.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Us**
------------

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home, and their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." We built a phone that works out of the box, AI check-in calls that surface how she's really doing, and a family app that replaces daily dread with peace of mind. Families tell us they used to wake up with a knot in their stomach. They don't anymore.

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That's not a policy. It's just who we are.

It is working, with tens of thousands of families trusting us. But most of the people who need us have never heard of us. By the end of 2027, we expect half of America's seniors will know who we are.

You will be the author of what they see. This isn't about directing a campaign. It's about building a courageous, iconic household brand close to scratch, with real budget and real creative license behind you. We aren't trying to rent attention. We want the kind of organic awareness that comes from people recognizing us, remembering us, and telling each other about us. If that's what you want to spend the next few years on, we'd love to talk.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* You will set our creative direction as we scale from <10% of American seniors and their families knowing about us to >50% in 2027. That’s millions of impressions. Super-bowl-commercial scale.
* You'll decide how Community Phone looks everywhere it shows up: TV, paid social, web, direct mail, the box, and our social channels. A family should recognize the same brand whether they see us at 9pm on TV or open the box at mom's house.
* You will be the steward of our brand, ensuring all platforms, from paid ads to customer newsletters, meet our brand standards.
* You'll take the brand identity system our design agency is launching in mid-October and make it world-class. Their work is the starting point. Scaling it across every surface and pushing it further is your job.
* You'll do the real work yourself. You'll design the website, the box, and the pieces that define us, and you'll be excited to make things rather than just advise on them.
* You'll build the creative machine for paid social and guarantee the quality of its output.
* You'll own creative performance alongside growth. Beautiful work that doesn't move CAC isn't done yet.
* You'll build the team that scales the brand with you.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* You have 8+ years in creative direction, and you've built a phenomenal consumer brand.
* You have a portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative work across digital, retail, social, packaging, experiential, film, photography, and product storytelling.
* You have both agency and in-house experience. You know how to get great work out of a studio, and you know what it takes to live with a brand every day.
* You grew up on the visual side of creative direction (art direction, design, motion), and you have real experience leading copy and concept too.
* You still love making the work. Your best days are the ones where you're designing, not sitting in review meetings.
* You believe in the power of AI in creative work. You use it every day, you know where it makes the work better, and you're excited about what it makes possible next.
* You've made creative that performs at scale, ideally across TV, paid social, and physical.
* You have experience managing production budgets, agencies, freelancers, and complex creative programs.
* You have excellent taste.
* You have superlatively high humility, intelligence, and hunger. Great creative reveals truths that were already there. It is a pursuit of truth just as much as a pursuit of beauty. The people who can do it seem to possess these three qualities to a high degree.
* You have the judgment to operate as the entire creative function today, and you want to push and be pushed by the growth team.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've designed packaging and unboxing for a consumer hardware or DTC product.
* You've worked on eldercare, health-adjacent, or other trust-sensitive consumer brands.

**How we work**
---------------

We're a fast-growing, YC-backed company built on curiosity, a bias toward action, and a founder mindset. We'd rather ship something small and learn than debate it for a month. You'll report directly to our Cofounder who runs Revenue and Operations, and you'll have a very direct line from your work to customers who will tell you, often within the same day, whether you got it right.

**How to apply**
----------------

Send us your portfolio, including the consumer brand you're proudest of building and what happened to it in market. Tell us briefly why building a brand for this kind of customer is interesting to you.

title: Creative Director
description:
EverOn Data Center Services is seeking a highly creative, strategic, and execution-oriented Creative Director to lead the development and implementation of the company's visual identity and creative initiatives across all marketing, sales, and corporate communications channels, including video production, podcast development, and multimedia storytelling.

As a key member of the Marketing & Sales team, the Creative Director will be responsible for translating EverOn's business objectives, brand positioning, and marketing strategies into compelling visual and multimedia experiences that strengthen brand recognition, support business development, and communicate the company's expertise in the mission-critical infrastructure industry.

This individual will serve as the organization's internal creative authority, ensuring brand consistency, design excellence, and high-quality execution across digital, print, presentations, proposals, events, video, podcasts, and other customer-facing materials. The Creative Director will also lead the creative development and production of video and podcast content, from concept and production planning through recording, editing, and final delivery.

The ideal candidate combines exceptional creative vision with strong project management capabilities and a hands-on approach to design, video, audio, and multimedia production. This role requires the ability to balance strategic creative thinking with day-to-day execution in a fast-paced, growing organization.

### **Key Responsibilities**

### **Creative Direction & Brand Management**

* Lead the creative direction and visual execution of EverOn's brand across internal and external communications.
* Serve as the primary steward of EverOn's visual identity, ensuring consistent application of brand standards across all channels and materials.
* Translate company positioning, business priorities, and marketing objectives into impactful creative concepts and visual communications.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, design systems, templates, and creative standards as the company grows.
* Establish and uphold standards for design quality, visual storytelling, multimedia production, and creative consistency.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen brand differentiation through innovative design and creative execution.
* Collaborate with the Chief Customer Officer to ensure creative initiatives align with overall business, marketing, and commercial strategies.

### **Creative Development & Production**

* Lead and execute the design and production of marketing, sales, and corporate communication materials.
* Develop and oversee creative assets, including:

  + Corporate presentations and executive communications
  + Proposal and RFP design elements
  + Digital and social media graphics
  + Website graphics and digital assets
  + Advertising and promotional material design
  + Event branding, signage, and environmental graphics
  + Case studies, infographics, and thought leadership design
  + Corporate videos, project videos, interviews, and promotional content
  + Podcast episodes, promotional clips, and supporting creative assets
  + Motion graphics, animation, and multimedia content
* Ensure all creative deliverables meet brand standards, quality expectations, and established deadlines.
* Adapt creative assets across multiple platforms, audiences, and formats while maintaining visual consistency.
* Oversee final artwork preparation, production specifications, and coordination with external vendors when necessary.
* Maintain an organized and accessible library of creative assets, templates, photography, video footage, audio recordings, and approved brand materials.

### **Video Production, Podcast Development & Multimedia Storytelling**

* Lead the creative development, production, and post-production of video and podcast content that supports EverOn's marketing, thought leadership, employer branding, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Collaborate with the marketing team, executive leadership, subject matter experts, and agency partners to develop video and podcast concepts aligned with established content strategies and business priorities.
* Plan and coordinate video shoots, podcast recordings, interviews, project footage, and other multimedia production activities.
* Direct or execute filming, audio recording, editing, motion graphics, sound design, and post-production activities.
* Develop and maintain consistent visual and audio branding for EverOn's video and podcast programming.
* Produce multimedia content for corporate communications, social media, website initiatives, recruiting, customer presentations, and industry thought leadership.
* Create short-form video clips, promotional trailers, audiograms, and other supporting assets to extend the reach and value of long-form content.
* Identify emerging multimedia formats, production technologies, and creative approaches that enhance EverOn's storytelling capabilities.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration & Agency Coordination**

* Work collaboratively with the Chief Customer Officer, marketing team, sales organization, executive leadership, and other internal stakeholders.
* Support the marketing team in the execution of campaigns, brand initiatives, corporate events, and digital marketing programs.
* Collaborate with internal content owners to translate approved messaging into visually engaging materials.
* Ensure creative work is aligned across internal teams and external partners while minimizing duplication of effort.

### **Creative Operations & Project Management**

* Manage the creative production process from initial concept through final delivery.
* Establish clear creative briefs, project timelines, production schedules, and approval workflows.
* Prioritize creative requests based on business impact, urgency, available resources, and established marketing priorities.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Identify opportunities to improve creative workflows, standardize processes, and increase production efficiency.
* Maintain visibility into creative project status, deliverables, timelines, and resource requirements.
* Ensure appropriate version control, file organization, and accessibility of final creative assets, including video and audio content.
* Evaluate and recommend creative tools, technologies, production equipment, and processes that improve quality and productivity.
* Provide guidance and creative feedback to internal contributors while fostering a collaborative, solutions-oriented environment.

### **Qualifications**

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, Multimedia Production, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in graphic design, creative development, brand management, multimedia production, or related creative disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading creative direction and managing complex creative projects.
* Exceptional portfolio showcasing expertise in branding, visual storytelling, presentation design, digital creative, and multimedia production.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and related design and editing applications.
* Demonstrated experience in video production, editing, and post-production workflows.
* Working knowledge of podcast development, audio recording, editing, and production processes.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to create sophisticated executive-level and customer-facing presentations.
* Experience developing and maintaining corporate brand guidelines and design systems.
* Strong understanding of digital, print, video, and audio production processes, file preparation, and creative asset management.
* Proven ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and execute projects with minimal oversight.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to receive and incorporate feedback while maintaining high creative standards.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in B2B marketing, construction, infrastructure, technology, or other technical industries.
* Experience producing corporate videos, executive interviews, project showcases, and thought leadership content.
* Experience developing, producing, or managing branded podcast series.
* Familiarity with video recording equipment, lighting, microphones, and podcast recording setups.
* Experience working collaboratively with external creative, marketing, and production agencies.
* Experience with Canva, Figma, and other collaborative creative platforms.
* Familiarity with marketing automation platforms and digital content management systems.
* Experience supporting a growing or evolving corporate brand.

**About EverOn Data Center Services**
-------------------------------------

EverOn Data Center Services is a mission-critical infrastructure company specializing in the delivery of complex data center construction solutions. Built on nearly two decades of industry experience and a heritage of data center ownership and operations, EverOn brings a unique understanding of the entire facility lifecycle to every project.

Serving hyperscale, enterprise, AI, and data center development customers, EverOn combines specialized technical expertise with a commitment to safety, quality, collaboration, and execution excellence.

Our core values—Excellence, People, Integrity, Collaboration, Accountability, and Fortitude—guide how we work, serve our customers, and build for the future.

title: Creative Director
description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Creative Director leads creative strategy, brand identity, and creative operations for High Profile's marketing organization. This role directs creative across every channel, with depth in paid and organic social, and builds AI-enabled systems that let the team scale. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at a strategic altitude while simultaneously able to get hands-on needed, doing the work and setting an example when needed. The Creative Director works with autonomy and brings fully formed recommendations to the VP of Marketing.

**JOB DUTIES:**

Core duties and responsibilities include the following.

**Creative Strategy & Brand Stewardship**

* Accountable for creative direction across every channel and format, including in-store, wholesale support, internal packaged brands, traditional media, paid digital, and organic social. Set the bar and give final creative approval before work goes to the VP of Marketing or other stakeholders.
* Lead creative ideation for tentpole campaigns. Facilitate brainstorms with marketing teams to generate the strongest ideas in the room. Set the creative throughline for each initiative: the core idea, tone, visual direction, and example executions, as inspiration for channel directors to build strategies against.
* Serve as the primary steward of brand identity across all channels once standards are established, holding the internal team and any outside partners or agencies accountable to them.
* Bring an external point of view on creative quality, benchmarking High Profile's output against strong work in retail, CPG, and adjacent categories, and raising the team's overall craft bar.

**Channel Expertise & Growth Channels**

* Define a high quality standard for High Profile's paid advertising creative across digital and traditional media, including display, paid social, video, direct mail, and out-of-home. Produce to that standard across all operating states and their compliance rules.
* Own creative direction and content quality for paid digital and organic social, partnering with the Digital team, which owns channel strategy, targeting, and media spend, to ensure content performs and reflects brand standards.
* Lead creative concepting for campaign and initiative-level work, including seasonal campaigns, brand initiatives, and new channel launches.
* Lead the Design Manager on creative direction for traditional media, maintaining quality and consistency in High Profile's highest-spend traditional channels.

**Creative Operations & Systems**

* Own and rethink High Profile's highest-volume recurring production processes, beginning with the weekly promotional workflow, identifying opportunities to reduce manual production time through AI-assisted tools and improved systems.
* Evaluate and implement AI and workflow tools across the creative team to increase throughput and creative capacity without adding headcount.

**Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic direction, workload prioritization, and professional development to the creative and design team.
* Build a scalable, well-documented creative operating model that teaches frameworks for creative thinking, brief writing, and critique.
* Report on creative team performance, capacity, and initiative progress to the VP of Marketing. Owns creative & design budget and manages to target.
* Builds productive working relationships within marketing and with cross-functional partners: buying & planning, retail, compliance, wholesale, and facilities.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Leads a team of four: Design Manager, Production Packaging Designer, Senior Graphic Designer, and Graphic Designer. This role directly manages the Design Manager, Packaging Designer, and Graphic Designer. Creative Director will also direct external paid media agencies.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

* 6+ years in creative roles, with at least 3 years as a Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or equivalent.
* 3+ years at an integrated, full-service, or brand agency in a concept-leading role (copywriter, Design Manager, ACD, or CD), creating campaign ideas rather than only producing assets.
* Agency work for retail, consumer, or regulated-category clients, including campaigns that ran in-store as well as in paid, social, and CRM channels.
* Portfolio with integrated work from concept through execution across three or more channels.
* Portfolio evidence of distinctive paid media creative across digital and traditional channels.
* Strong, current point of view on social-native content, ideally with experience connecting content quality to measurable performance.
* Experience building or improving creative production systems and workflows, familiarity with AI-assisted workflows strongly preferred.
* Experience managing a creative or design team of 3+ people.
* Experience leading brainstorms or concept development with cross-functional partners who don't report to them, with examples of ideas others built out across channels.
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and bringing proactive recommendations to leadership.
* Cannabis or other regulated industry experience a plus, but not required.

title: Freelance Creative Director – Social Media Video Production

NinjaTrader is hiring a Creative Director to own how the company looks, sounds and feels across every marketing surface a consumer encounters. This is the senior-most creative role in the marketing organization, reporting directly to the CMO.

Our brand strategy and positioning are sharp, but the visual expression lags behind.. This is an opportunity to level up our visual identity to reflect the dynamic and growing nature of the brands we have in market. Then your job is to make it real — operationalize it, extend it into the places it doesn't yet reach, and defend it as volume scales. After that, you own the creative standard for the group.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set direction, and you will still be in the file. We are not hiring someone to run a review calendar.

Trading is a category of noise: identical charts, identical claims, identical stock photography of men in headsets. The mandate is to make NinjaTrader unmistakable.

**In this role you will:**

The marketing identity system

* Operationalize the incoming brand identity system — typography, color, photography and illustration direction, motion language, iconography, layout systems — and extend it into the surfaces it does not yet cover
* Own the marketing design system: build it to scale across campaign, web, lifecycle and partner surfaces, and to hold up when other hands use it

* Act as the final quality gate on brand expression across marketing

* Build the operating rhythm — briefs, reviews, handoffs — that lets a small team ship at volume
* Grow into broader creative ownership over time, including copy and video production

Cross-functional leadership

* Partner with Product Design on shared brand guidelines so marketing and platform surfaces stay recognizably the same brand. Product Design owns the product design system; you own the marketing one. The two are deliberately scoped differently and should stay that way
* Work with performance marketing to build creative that is testable, iterable and measured against funnel outcomes

* A portfolio built on systems, not one-offs
* Storytelling range — able to develop narrative, not only art-direct someone else's script
* Range across brand campaign work and performance creative
* A desire to remain hands-on — actively driven to stay in the work, not just direct it
* Fluency with AI tooling in the creative process
* A track record of managing designers and directing external agencies
* Comfort with performance data

* Experience running a marketing design system alongside a separately owned product design system
* Experience in a constrained or regulated environment — finance, healthcare, insurance, pharma or gaming

title: Design Director, Brand
description:
**About AlphaSense**
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
  
  
**Location:**
New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
  
  
**About The Team**
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the
**Design Director**
on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
  
  
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
* A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
* Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
* A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
* A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
* A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
* Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
* Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.

**What You’ll Do**

* Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
* Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
* Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
* Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
* Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
* Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
* Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
* Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.
