title: Engineering Director, EU
description:
***We're on a mission to make money work for everyone.***

We're waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We're not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London or Remote (UK) or Barcelona, Spain (Hybrid)

### **Engineering at Monzo**

Monzo has successfully launched in Ireland and is expanding across Europe. We're now entering the next phase of our journey: building and scaling a multi-market European bank.

The EU Engineering organisation sits at the centre of that ambition. We are responsible for helping Monzo launch, grow and operate across Europe, navigating everything from product-market fit and customer growth to regulatory requirements, localisation and operational scale.

Unlike most engineering organisations at Monzo, EU does not own a single product area. We work horizontally across the company, partnering with teams across Payments, Core Banking, Growth, Wealth, Customer Operations, Fincrime, Platform and many others to bring Monzo's products to new markets and deliver great customer experiences locally.

As an Engineering Director, you'll lead a distributed engineering organisation across the UK, Spain and remote locations. You'll partner closely with Product, Design, Data, Operations, Risk, Compliance and executive stakeholders to solve complex problems that span organisational boundaries.

Success in this role comes through influence, relationships and organisational leadership as much as execution. You'll need to build alignment across a wide range of teams, create clarity in ambiguity, and help Monzo discover what works in new markets while establishing the foundations that allow us to scale across Europe.

This is one of Monzo's most strategically important areas and a unique opportunity to help build a European bank from the ground up.

**What you'll work on**

* Lead a distributed engineering organisation spanning multiple squads, markets and countries.
* Build and develop Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior technical leaders.
* Partner with Product, Design, Data, Research, Operations, Risk and Compliance leaders to define and execute Monzo's European strategy.
* Drive alignment and execution across numerous collectives to ensure Europe receives the capabilities it needs to succeed.
* Shape how Monzo approaches market expansion, localisation, regulatory requirements and multi-market product development.
* Influence priorities and outcomes across teams that do not directly report to you.
* Create clarity and momentum in highly ambiguous problem spaces where ownership and solutions are not always obvious.
* Design and evolve organisational structures, operating models and planning processes that allow Monzo to scale effectively across Europe.
* Help identify and validate product-market fit in new markets while balancing short-term delivery and long-term strategic investments.
* Partner closely with executive leadership to shape the future of Monzo's European business.

### **You should apply if**

* You have experience leading large engineering organisations through other leaders, including Engineering Managers, Senior Engineering Managers and senior individual contributors.
* You have successfully operated in highly complex organisations where outcomes depend on collaboration across many teams and functions.
* You are exceptional at building relationships and influencing without direct authority.
* You can navigate ambiguity and create clarity where goals, ownership or priorities are not yet fully defined.
* You have experience scaling organisations through periods of rapid growth, organisational change or market expansion.
* You enjoy solving organisational and business problems, not just technical ones.You can balance strategy and execution, translating ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.
* You are comfortable making decisions in environments where there is rarely a perfect answer.
* You have a strong track record of building high-performing leadership teams and developing future leaders.
* You are energised by the challenge of building something new and helping shape the future of Monzo's international expansion.

### **The interview process**

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call our interview process involves 2 main stages:

* **Initial Call (1 hour)** You'll meet with one of our senior engineering leaders. They'll ask you about your previous experience, in particular people leadership, product delivery and technical leadership. They'll ask example based questions ('Tell me about a time when…')

* **Loop Stage** - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as execution and leadership interviews.

At all stages we'll create space for you to ask as many questions as you have, you're interviewing us as well!

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com. Please also use that email to let us know if there's anything we can do to make your application process easier for you, because of disability, neurodiversity or any other personal reason.

  

**How we work :**

**Locations & Flexible Working (If you're in the UK) :**

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there's no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays ️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

**Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.**

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You'll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. ✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

### **What's in it for you**

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK or Spain

✅ We can sponsor visas for the UK (not Spain)

This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

* We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 ( a year for books, training courses and conferences

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we're making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we're embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
description:
**About the opportunity**
=========================

We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.

Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.

### **In this role, you will**

* **Drive the Core ML Platform Vision:** Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
* **Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios:** Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
* **Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure:** Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
* **Establish Model Evaluation and Governance:** Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
* **Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance:** Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
* **Elevate and Mentor the PM Function:** Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.

### **What you need to be successful**

#### **Background & Experience**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
* **High-Volume B2C Scale:** Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
* **Strategic & Portfolio Leadership:** Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.

#### **Technical & Domain Skills**

* **Deep ML and MLOps Literacy:** Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
* **Analytical and Evaluation Rigor:** Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
* **Latency and System Trade-Offs:** Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
* **Financial Governance and Compliance:** Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.

#### **Traits**

* **Platform Visionary:** Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
* **Decisive Technical Leader:** Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
* **Uncompromising Quality Standard:** High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.

### **What's in it for you**

* Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe's premier digital banks.
* Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
* A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
* An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
* High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.
* A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

### **Who we are**

N26 has reimagined banking for today's digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it's how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

**Sounds good? Apply now for this position.**

### **Equal Opportunities**

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

title: Program Manager, REFS Technology
description:
### **Summary**

Location: Barcelona, Spain #LI-Hybrid
  
  
Internal job title: Associate Director - Program Manager, REFS Technology
  
  
This role is based in Barcelona. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.
  
  
About the Role:
  
The Program Manager, REFS Technology is accountable for the end-to-end leadership of a portfolio of complex, cross-functional technology programs supporting Real Estate & Facility Services globally.
  
The role translates REFS strategy and business priorities into executable technology roadmaps, integrated program plans, and measurable outcomes. It aligns Business, DDIT, Architecture, Security, Procurement, Finance, Operations, and external partners while maintaining clear governance, financial control, delivery discipline, and executive transparency.
  
This position ensures that interdependent REFS technology initiatives deliver sustainable business value, remain aligned with enterprise standards, and transition successfully into operations, including the responsible adoption of AI, automation, and robotics where these technologies create measurable operational value.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Program Strategy & Roadmap:** Own the definition and delivery of multi-year REFS technology programs and roadmaps aligned with business priorities and DDIT strategy, ranslating strategic priorities into executable plans, measurable business outcomes, and aligned cross-functional delivery while proactively challenging risks, dependencies, scope, and investment decisions to ensure successful execution.
* **End-to-End Program Delivery:** Lead programs from demand shaping and initiation through design, build, deployment, adoption, operational handover, and benefits realization, driving integrated planning, cross-functional execution, delivery accountability, and proactive risk mitigation to ensure successful business outcomes.
* Governance, Portfolio & Decision Management: Establish proportionate governance aligned with DDIT and REFS standards, including phase gates, steering committees, decision forums, and reporting cadence; provide executive-ready program status, decision papers, risk assessments, financial views, and recommendations.

title: Strategic Account Manager (Growth)
description:
**The Dcycle Vision.**
----------------------

Every company will be profoundly impacted by the adoption of artificial intelligence over the next five years. The companies that make the most of this shift will gain a competitive advantage over the rest.

AI models are already capable of automating a large part of business operations and processes. The problem is that companies are not yet ready to unlock that potential. For AI to be truly useful, it needs context. Today, however, information remains scattered across spreadsheets, systems, suppliers, and departments, making it difficult for AI to understand the business and act effectively.

Dcycle solves this. We bring financial, operational, and supply chain data together in a single, trusted source of truth, enabling teams and AI agents to work from the same data.

### **Your Role: Strategic Account Manager (Growth)**

You own the growth of around 40-50 key Dcycle customers in Spain, and you share with the team a wider portfolio of smaller accounts. Your job is to help each of them get more value from Dcycle and buy more: new modules, new sites and new buyers inside the company, from procurement and IT to finance and general management. You run quarterly business reviews with key accounts, take complex topics (a new regulation, a market benchmark, a technical use case) and explain them simply, and open doors to the management committee and to our international team. You report to the Head of Sales Spain.

#### ***What Your First Months Will Look Like***

**You'll hit the ground running.** In your first weeks you'll learn the product inside out (automated data collection, multi-framework reporting, product LCA, supplier engagement, ISO management systems and Leia, our built-in AI), meet your portfolio together with Customer Success and map each account: who buys, what they use and what they are missing.

**By month three,** you'll have account plans for your key customers, you'll have run your first QBRs and closed your first expansion deals, including our new products for quality and procurement teams.

**By month six,** you'll be selling to buyers outside sustainability in several accounts and you'll be on track with your quota.

### **What you'll do**

* Own the expansion of your 40-50 key accounts (upsell, cross-sell, new sites and new buyers), and work the shared portfolio through Customer Success signals and campaigns.
* Prepare and run quarterly business reviews with key accounts: results, benchmarks against their sector, upcoming regulation and next steps.
* Research complex topics (new regulations, market benchmarks, technical use cases), simplify them and present them so that a CFO or a plant manager gets it in five minutes.
* Sell our newer products, such as ISO management systems and supplier evaluation, to procurement, IT, finance and quality teams.
* Take relationships up to the management committee, and connect international customers with our international team.
* Work hand in hand with Customer Success: they own adoption and renewal, you own growth.
* Keep your pipeline and forecast up to date in HubSpot, and use AI to research, build benchmarks and prepare your QBRs.

### **Soft Skills: How we work**

At Dcycle, your title no longer describes everything you do. Speed changed our culture: anyone can build, and AI agents multiply what each of us gets done. We expect three things from everyone who joins:

* **You build your own solutions.** When you find a problem, you don't wait for someone else to fix it. You design the solution, build it and put it into the world, whether it is a playbook, an automation or an agent that does part of the work.
* **You keep learning.** What you know today isn't enough for tomorrow. You pick up new disciplines and areas of knowledge so that no problem or obstacle stops you.
* **You are honest and accountable.** You share what you are building before you build it, you own the outcome and not just the output, and you say things as they are.

For this role we also need you to be a **great communicator**: you turn something complex into a clear story, and you are comfortable presenting it to a management committee.

We are managers of one and many: we run our own work and we orchestrate AI agents to multiply it. In return, the company removes bureaucracy and protects good-faith mistakes.

### **Technical Skills**

Minimum Requirements

* 5-8 years in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years in account management, expansion or customer-facing sales at C-level.
* A track record of growing accounts and hitting expansion targets.
* You have sold to procurement, IT, finance or general management.
* You write and present very well, and you have run QBRs or presentations to management committees.
* You understand technical use cases well enough to explain them; you don't need to configure them.
* You already use AI in your daily work. We will ask you to show us how.
* Languages: bilingual Spanish and English.

We value skills that include:

* A degree in engineering, environmental science, economics or similar.
* Knowledge of ESG, quality management (ISO), procurement or supply chain.
* Experience with industrial or food and beverage companies.

We’re not just looking for experience; we’re looking for people with a growth mindset who can drive innovation and challenge the status quo.

### **Salary & Benefits**

* Competitive base DOE + uncapped variable. The more you grow your accounts, the more you earn.
* 23 paid vacation days
* 7 days of team-building per year
* Flexible compensation through Factorial: meals, transport and childcare, taken out of gross salary
* Subsidized training for continuous development
* Flexible work schedule

  + Start anytime between 8:00-9:30 AM
  + Leave anytime between 5:30-7:00 PM (Monday-Thursday)
  + Finish at 3:00 PM on Fridays

### **Hybrid Work Model**

* First month: Onsite (to immerse yourself in the team and product)
* After that: 3 days in our Madrid office, 2 days remote each week
* Extra remote days for parents, long commutes
* Full remote work (optional) from the end of Summer team building until September warm-up week, and from the end of Winter team building through to January 6th.
* Start date: between November 2026 and January 2027

### **Interview Process**

We have a thorough but efficient hiring process:

* **Screening Call:** A short intro call where we explain Dcycle and the role, confirm your availability, salary alignment and walk you through timelines.
* **Interview with Talent:** Your first real conversation, sharing your story, motivation, and experience so we can get to know you and set you up for the next steps.
* **Interview with the Hiring Manager:** A deep-dive with the CRO testing your hard and soft skills through detailed examples and probing follow-ups.
* **Values Interview:** A chat with a Values Champion to understand how you live a specific Dcycle value in practice and test your cultural fit with the company.
* **Interview with Operations:** A practical session that stress-tests your resilience, attention to detail, and consistency, ending with time for your questions.
* **Interview with the Founders:** A final conversation to confirm mutual fit, trust, and that you’ll help raise Dcycle’s talent bar.

### **FAQ**

### **What’s the hiring process like?**

It’s tough but fair. We want to make sure you’re a great fit, so we’ll assess your technical skills, values, and potential. We provide feedback within 2 days and aim to move quickly.

### **How can I prepare for the interview process?**

We recommend reviewing the job description thoroughly, researching our company culture, and preparing for both technical and behavioral interview questions. Practice technical tasks to be ready for any technical rounds.

### **Can I apply if I’m outside of Spain?**

If you have a valid work permit for Spain and are willing to relocate to Madrid, we’re happy to consider your application. We don’t sponsor visas

### **Can I apply for multiple positions at once?**

Yes, you are welcome to apply for multiple positions that align with your skills and interests. We will assess your suitability for each role and reach out if there's a match.

title: Performance Media Buyer
description:
### **About ExoClick**

ExoClick is an innovative and global ad company serving 20 billion daily geo-targeted ads to web and mobile advertisers & publishers. We are part of EXOGROUP, a set of companies made up of +200 talents and offering a wide range of services within the digital business landscape with headquarters in Barcelona and offices in Dublin, Porto and Valencia.

We are revolutionizing the online ad-serving industry for advertisers, publishers, and networks alike and are seeking to recruit a Performance Media Buyer for our Barcelona office.

### **Role**

As Performance Media Buyer, you will work with global performance-based online advertisers across a wide variety of verticals within the adult entertainment industry. You will actively create, monitor and optimize campaigns for a portfolio of clients (both assigned and newly qualified leads) with a particular focus on effective inventory monetization, delivering a first-class service and sharing best practices within the various internal departments. Your daily tasks will also involve data analysis, preparing strategic client reports, proposals and contracts.

Together with a cross functional team, you will participate in development on new products and new marketing angles. As a top-notch media buyer you should educate and coach new media buyers in developing advertising strategies and campaigns. You will report to the Sales Director.

### **Responsibilities**

* Media buy on CPM, CPC, and CPV pricing models to back into CPA goals.
* Setup, manage and optimize campaigns using ExoClick Ad platform.
* Use of internal tools, systems and processes to keep a daily track of client development and expansion.
* Prospect and identify new potential direct response advertisers.
* Daily spend/revenue monitoring.
* Effective client relationship management, dealing with internal/external conflicts and collate best practice examples of reporting, client feedback and case studies.
* Proven technical capabilities and understanding, including basic skills in the editing of landing pages (HTML), use of tracking pixels and creative optimization.
* Close interaction with Business Intelligence, Business Development teams in order to interpret market insights, client data, and be able to react quickly and implement this back into the business.
* Effective management of your clients on performance versus target and company growth strategies.
* Support and coach existing and new employees. Help Performance team members by providing additional steps and resources that help employees move ahead with confidence.
* Collaborate with multiple departments in creation of documentation, educational material, case studies.
* Develop and incorporate new marketing angles in the user flows. Guide the marketing team on how to implement them in the marketing material.
* Participate in establishment and improvement of relevant processes of the department.
* Take responsibility and accountability over new products and projects within the department.

### **Profile**

* You have a solid working knowledge of the digital performance and affiliate marketing ecosystems, and understand the general needs of online advertisers and publishers
* Very detail-oriented with a meticulous approach and be able to manage multiple campaigns successfully
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Money conscious with an innovative approach and ability to thrive in a fast-paced working environment
* Proactive, a strong communicator and confident with pitching new opportunities to external clients
* Analytical mind, good with calculations and statistical interpretation
* Problem-solving attitude
* Interest in following advertising and media trends

### **Requirements**

* +2 years minimum experience in the online advertising industry as a media buyer.
* Previous Developing effective media buying strategies.
* Experience with RevShare models.
* Experience managing 6 digit campaigns directly for product owners or affiliate networks.
* We will value any experience as a media buyer or traffic manager. Previous experience with ExoClick Platform is a highly appreciated.
* Strong analytical proficiency, especially with Excel or Google spreadsheets.
* Good technical knowledge (HTML).
* Perfect knowledge of the different performance-based pricing models (CPA, CPL, CPM, CPC, etc.).
* Fluent English, written and spoken (Russian, German, French, Spanish or other languages will be highly valued).
* Strong proficiency with web applications (browsers, software).
* Experience with tracking and attribution tools.

### **What you’ll find working at ExoClick**

We offer a position in a young, dynamic and international team with exceptional working conditions in unique offices high up in the Torre Mapfre, one of Barcelona’s world-renowned landmarks, located right on the city’s seafront.

Additionally, we offer the opportunity for permanent training, personal development, ambitious career growth, and a competitive salary.

Most of all, we offer a position in a team that thrives on achievement, success, and leadership within our industry. Our core company value is innovation: where people and creativity drive innovative technology. If you have an innovative, winning mentality, this position is for you!

### **Our company benefits**

* Flexitime and summer schedule
* Private health insurance
* Your Birthday off as a paid holiday
* Flexible compensation plan: travel, meals & childcare
* Additional internal and external training through our EXOGROUP University program
* English, Portuguese & Spanish classes

title: Senior Client Solutions Manager - Influencer Marketing (6 Month FTC) | Europe
description:
**About Kyra**
--------------

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Europe (Remote) | 9-month Fixed-Term Contract  
Competitive, dependent on experience  
  
**The Opportunity**

You will be the day-to-day owner of one of Kyra's largest and most complex global enterprise accounts: a fast-moving, multi-category consumer brand with 12+ sub-brands, 35+ active stakeholders, and campaigns running simultaneously across multiple regions.

Your job is to keep delivery tight, keep the client happy, and be a safe pair of hands on a flagship account. This is not about growing or expanding the account. The commercial relationship is locked in. The job is world-class servicing at enterprise scale.

**What you'll do:**

* Own the global account relationship across 12+ sub-brands and multiple regions. Stay organised across a volume of comms, briefs, and stakeholders that is genuinely unusual.
* Orchestrate cross-functional teams: creative, paid media, creator partnerships, and product. You are the connective tissue. If something drifts, you see it early and fix it.
* If something drifts (performance, scope, relationship, or timeline) you see it early and fix it. No surprises. Steady, organised ownership.

**Lead the Relationship** Own client relationships across product launches, seasonal campaigns, and always-on programmes. Multi-thread across their teams. Build trust at every level. Have direct conversations when performance needs to improve.

**Turn Insight into Strategy** Translate campaign data into clear, executive-level recommendations using AI to move from raw numbers to narrative faster. Present performance against KPIs (engagement, EMV, sales lift, affiliate impact) and explain what it means.

**Own Delivery End-to-End** Lead client onboarding for new briefs: build decks, verify SOW accuracy, coordinate internal teams, demo the platform. Manage timelines, scopes, budgets, and execution across our full product suite, including Always-On creator partnerships, Pulse campaigns, Makers (CGC), Amplify+ (paid boosting), Seeding+, and License+. With 6+ briefs running simultaneously, operational precision is everything. Keep work on-brand, on-time, and within margin.

**Protect & Grow Revenue** Lead post-campaign analysis: run internal post-mortems, build PCA decks, present performance narratives. Own exec-ready reporting (QBRs/EBRs). Reporting should inform decisions, not just recap them.

**Keep the System Tight** Keep tracking clean. Watch capacity. Fix what's inefficient. Make sure client feedback doesn't get lost. Feed client insights back into product development.  
  
**Feed Insight Back into Product** Surface client needs, pain points, and feature requests back into the product team. You are the closest person to how the client actually uses the platform.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who has:

* 4–6+ years in influencer or creator marketing
* Campaign execution experience. You have actually run creative marketing activations, not just managed client relationships from a distance.
* Enterprise account servicing at scale. Multi-stakeholder, high-volume, complex. You have managed accounts with this many moving parts before.
* Exceptional organisation. The volume of comms, briefs, regions, and stakeholders on this account is unusually high. Getting lost is easy. You don't get lost.
* Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset. You take ownership of learning, build internal relationships proactively, and don't wait to be told what to do.
* Strong hands-on campaign experience, with real fluency in TikTok.
* AI fluency, applied. Our platform is AI-powered and you'll be expected to get up to speed fast and use it daily for client summaries, performance narratives, and campaign analysis. We're looking for people already comfortable using AI tools in their workflow, so the learning curve is the platform, not the concept.
* Comfortable working across project management tools (Asana, Airtable, Slack) and reporting dashboards.
* CPG or multi-category consumer brand experience is a plus.

You should be commercially sharp, operationally reliable, and able to speak confidently about the accounts you've managed.

**Traits That Matter**
  
Proactive. Organised. Adaptable. Self-starting. Comfortable with ambiguity.

You don't wait for problems to land. You see them coming and act. You don't need rigid processes or hand-holding. Tools, product, and ways of working evolve constantly here, and you thrive on that.

You're willing to say "I don't know" and go find out. You take feedback well. You build trust fast.

**What Success Looks Like** **What Success Looks Like**
  
  
**By Month 1:** You have full context on all active sub-brands, briefs, and stakeholders. You've built a strong working relationship with the Campaign Director and the internal pod. The client knows your name and trusts you to run things.

**By Month 3:** Delivery is running smoothly across all regions. You own reporting and client comms without oversight. Post-campaign analysis is sharp and drives clear recommendations. Internal teams come to you, not around you.

**By Month 6:** The account is in better shape than when you arrived. Stakeholder satisfaction is high. Nothing has been dropped. Leadership trusts your judgement completely.  
  
**Benefits**

Hybrid working. 3 days per week in-office, 4 days during your first 2 weeks of onboarding.  
**Annual Time Off:** 25 days PTO (pro-rated) + bank holidays (pro-rated), 4 company-wide days off (Kyra Days), 3 wellness days, and paid sick leave each year  
**Growth:** Annual Learning & Development budget to invest in your skills.  
**Rewards:** Annual bonus scheme to recognise great work

title: Client Solutions Director / Solution Design Architect
description:
Established in 2004, **OLIVER** is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of **The Brandtech Group**, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our **AI solutions** enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

### **Solution Design Architect (AI / Transformation / Creative Operations)**

**Language requirement:** fluency in German or Spanish

**Location:** Spain (primarily remote) and regular business travel across EMEA

**Employment:** permanent

**About the role:**

We're hiring a Solution Design Architect to help us win and shape new business. You'll sit in the room with senior client stakeholders, including CMOs, and turn their challenges into operating models, workflows and commercial models (team shapes, asset rates, outcome-based structures) that we can deliver. You'll bring the commercial judgement to validate the numbers, the process thinking to design better ways of working, and the technical and channel knowledge to lead the conversation when specialists aren't there. Quick on your feet and calm under pressure, you'll be supported by our Commercial and Implementation teams.

#### **Key Responsibilities:**

#### **New Business and Client Engagement**

* Lead the operational and solution design element of new client pitches, presenting with credibility and confidence to senior client stakeholders, including CMOs and marketing leadership.
* Formulate solutions in real time during pitches, workshops and challenging client discussions, staying composed and commercially sharp.
* Own the conversation on technology and data when technical specialists aren't present, and know when and how to bring them in.
* Ensure a smooth handover from pitch to implementation, so what we sell is what we deliver.

#### **Requirement Gathering and Analysis**

* Work with stakeholders to gather, document and analyse business requirements for new client accounts.
* Ask the right questions to define accurate scope, cost and risk.
* Translate client business needs into workflows for client and technology teams.

#### **Operating Model and Solution Design**

* Define and articulate operating model principles (roles, governance, ways of working, handoffs) that align to client goals and our delivery capability.
* Evaluate existing client and internal processes, identify new ways of working, and recommend improvements for efficiency, cost reduction and better outcomes.
* Design solutions across advertising and marketing channels, drawing on a strong understanding of how media, data, creative and technology fit together.
* Collaborate with technology and business teams to ensure solutions align with our strategy and are technically feasible.

#### **Commercial Modelling**

* Build, test and validate commercial models that deliver the designed workflow, including team shapes, asset-based rate models and outcome-based models.
* Work with Commercial and Finance to pressure-test assumptions, margins and risk before models go to clients.
* Balance client value with commercial viability, and explain the reasoning clearly to both internal and client audiences.

#### **Stakeholder Communication**

* Act as the bridge between clients, commercial, technology and delivery teams, ensuring shared understanding and alignment.
* Translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, compelling narratives for non-technical, senior audiences.

#### **Data, Measurement and Reporting**

* Analyse data to support decision-making, and define measurement frameworks for new clients.
* Create reports and presentations that convey findings and recommendations with clarity and impact.

#### **About You:**

#### **Essential**

* 10-15 years' experience in solution design, consulting, strategy, operations or a similar role within advertising, marketing, media or marketing technology.
* A confident, articulate communicator with a track record of presenting to and influencing C-suite and senior marketing stakeholders (CMOs or equivalent).
* Commercial acumen, with hands-on experience building and validating pricing or commercial models (e.g. resourcing/team-shape models, rate cards, outcome-based or performance-linked structures).
* A process-driven mindset, able to map, challenge and redesign ways of working and articulate clear operating model principles.
* Strong working knowledge of advertising and marketing channels (e.g. paid media, social, programmatic, search, CRM, creative production) and how they connect to data and technology.
* Enough technical fluency in martech, adtech, data and platforms to hold credible conversations with clients and lead when technical specialists aren't in the room.
* Quick-thinking and resilient, comfortable formulating answers and options in high-pressure or contentious situations while maintaining client confidence.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into insight and recommendations.
* Willingness and flexibility to travel regularly for client pitches, mostly across Europe and occasionally further afield.

#### **Desirable**

* Experience contributing to new business wins, RFPs and pitch processes.
* Experience in an agency, consultancy or in-house marketing transformation environment.
* Experience with global or multi-market clients and remote, cross-functional teams.

#### **What Success Looks Like:**

* Contribute directly to new business wins and improve pitch win rates.
* Commercial models that are profitable, credible to clients and deliverable in practice.
* Smooth transitions from pitch to implementation with no gap between what was sold and what is delivered.
* Trusted by clients, commercial and technology teams as the go-to person for solution design.

title: Editor, Marketing
description:
**About Darkroom**

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).

As a Video Editor on Darkroom’s internal Marketing Team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the visual storytelling behind our brand. You'll work closely with our Video Lead, Design Lead, and Director to transform raw content into engaging, high-impact videos for platforms like Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, and LinkedIn. This is a fast-moving, creative, and collaborative role for someone with sharp instincts, strong technical skills, and a passion for crafting content that connects with audiences.

In this role, you’ll develop a scalable, high-output video content engine that fuels Darkroom’s brand voice. You’ll design a creative system for rapid, high-quality production across channels, repurposing standout moments from podcasts, events, and behind-the-scenes footage. With a performance-driven approach to storytelling, you’ll adapt quickly to platform shifts, experiment with new formats, and continuously refine output based on real-world results.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.**

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**Social-First Video Editing**

* Edit and produce standout content across short-form (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) and long-form (YouTube, webinars).
* Create native video formats optimized for IG, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok, and X, including repurposed edits and cutdowns.
* Build scroll-stopping hooks, apply text overlays, closed captions, sound design, and motion graphics that support performance.
* Turn voice notes, podcasts, webinars and interviews into polished, platform-native video content.
* Surface and extract the most compelling moments from raw footage: podcast soundbites, behind-the-scenes gems, founder tangents, interviews, etc.
* Collaborate with the Video Lead on edits, structure, and narrative framing.
* Organize, tag, and manage footage to create a systemized pipeline for recurring content formats.
* Understand performance data and collaborate with the marketing team to refine editing strategies based on what drives reach, engagement, and conversion.
* Test hooks, variations and formats to optimize output over time.
* Stay ahead of editing trends and platform algorithm shifts.

### **Production Excellence**

* Apply finishing touches: color correction, transitions, graphics, and text effects that align with the Darkroom brand language.
* Deliver content in multiple aspect ratios and formats for cross-platform distribution.
* Maintain high audio fidelity, visual clarity, and consistent branding across deliverables.
* Proactively troubleshoot creative or technical challenges and recommend solutions.
* Support post-production for Darkroom’s podcast and event recordings.
* Add intros/outros, audio enhancements, and accessible subtitles.

**You’re a Great Fit If You:**
------------------------------

* Have 3-4+ years of experience editing content for social-first brands, creators, or agencies.
* Know your way around Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, and have working knowledge of After Effects, Photoshop and motion graphics.
* Have a sharp eye for storytelling, pacing, and rhythm, and you know how to build content that keeps attention.
* Understand editing for performance, not just aesthetics. You know what performs on TikTok vs. YT Shorts vs. LinkedIn.
* Are fluent in optimizing content across multiple aspect ratios and formats.
* Can own your edit from concept to final export while staying collaborative, communicative, and open to feedback.
* Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments where no two days (or edits) are the same.
* Are organized, meticulous, and always ready with a plan B (or C).

### **Bonus Points If You:**

* Have experience editing founder-led content or personal brand material.
* Have worked on performance-driven or growth marketing creative.
* Use AI tools (Descript, Runway, etc.) for cutdowns, transcription, or speeding up your workflow.

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:

* Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
* Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
* Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.

Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

QAD solutions help customers in the automotive, life sciences, packaging, consumer products, food and beverage, high tech and industrial manufacturing industries rapidly adapt to change and innovate for competitive advantage.

**QAD** is seeking a **Global Revenue Marketing Manager** to own and execute strategic go-to-market campaigns and drive pipeline generation globally. This role is based in EMEA (Spain/UK preferred) and reports to the Director of Revenue Marketing.

This role sits within the Revenue Marketing team and partners closely with the Director of Revenue Marketing and the broader Revenue Marketing organization to set strategy, run integrated campaigns, and deliver pipeline contributions globally.

This role is responsible for deciding and developing *both customer and new logo* revenue campaigns, focusing on industry-specific campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and drive measurable revenue impact across QAD's manufacturing solutions portfolio.

You will partner closely with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, and global channel partners to run multi-channel GTM motions, from account-based strategies to broad-based demand generation, executing against the global pipeline plan set in partnership with the Director of Revenue Marketing.

*This remote role requires 10–15% travel to represent and align marketing strategies at key industry gatherings, including Champions of Manufacturing (CoM) events, annual Sales Kickoffs, and integrated marketing planning meetings.*

**What You’ll Do**

* Decide and develop customer and new logo revenue campaigns, with a focus on industry-specific campaigns, in partnership with the Director of Revenue Marketing
* Run strategic GTM motions, including ABM, digital campaigns, and webinars, aligned to global pipeline goals
* Build and execute integrated campaigns (email, digital, webinars, ABM) targeting priority accounts and segments globally, across both customer and new logo audiences
* Execute and participate in industry conferences and trade events to drive brand visibility, lead generation, and account engagement globally
* Support execution of customer events and programs, driving registrations, engagement, and pipeline follow-up
* Partner with Sales and Business Development to align campaigns with territory plans, account priorities, and pipeline targets
* Work with global channel partners to extend campaign reach and drive co-marketing pipeline contribution
* Coordinate with the Product Marketing team on shared messaging, positioning, and campaign assets, ensuring consistent global execution
* Drive demand generation and pipeline acceleration programs tailored to industry and regional market dynamics and buyer behavior
* Develop segmentation and targeting recommendations by industry, geography, and buying stage

* Track pipeline performance from campaign inception through to revenue, flagging funnel risks to the Director and Sales
* Partner with Sales to improve conversion and progression where opportunities are stalling
* Maintain pipeline hygiene and SLA accountability, ensuring timely follow-up, clear stage progression, and accurate data capture across all marketing-generated opportunities
* Report on weekly campaign performance, recommending spend and optimization adjustments
* Partner with Marketing Ops and RevOps on data, reporting, and campaign execution; maintain dashboards to track pipeline, conversion, and ROI
* Work with Localization teams to adapt messaging and GTM programs across global languages and markets

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.

* **GTM & ABM Strategy:** Experience developing and executing go-to-market strategies and account-based marketing programs aligned with business priorities, target accounts, and revenue goals.
* **Self-starter and proactive approach** is required to enable working both independently but also collaboratively.
* **Integrated Campaigns:** Proven ability to plan and execute multi-channel campaigns across email, paid media, digital advertising, events, webinars, and sales-driven programs.
* **International Experience Required:** Demonstrated experience executing marketing programs across international markets, adapting campaigns and messaging to regional business needs.
* **Sales & Marketing Alignment:** Strong ability to collaborate with Sales, Business Development, Product Marketing, and regional teams to accelerate pipeline and drive revenue growth.
* **Data-Driven Marketing:** Strong understanding of marketing KPIs, funnel conversion, campaign attribution, pipeline contribution, and ROI to optimize performance.
* **Marketing Technology & AI:** Proficiency in Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, digital marketing tools, and emerging AI-powered technologies. Experience with Google Workspace required.
* **Project Management & Execution:** Highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple campaigns, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* **Collaboration & Ownership:** Results-oriented, creative, proactive, and adaptable, with excellent communication skills, strong accountability, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams.

 **Additional Information**

**Compensation Package:**

* Base pay range: 65,000 EUR - 70,000 EUR (12 Months) base salary
* Placement within our pay range will vary based on knowledge, skills, experience, and market location variations as well as internal peer equity.
* This role is eligible for the Marketing Bonus Plan.

**About QAD:**

QAD | Redzone is redefining manufacturing and supply chains through its intelligent, adaptive platform that connects people, processes, and data into a single System of Action. With three core pillars — Redzone (frontline empowerment), Adaptive Applications (the intelligent backbone), and Champion AI (Agentic AI for manufacturing) — QAD | Redzone helps manufacturers operate with Champion Pace, achieving measurable productivity, resilience, and growth in just 90 days.

QAD is committed to ensuring that every employee feels they work in an environment that values their contributions, respects their unique perspectives and provides opportunities for growth regardless of background. If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game!

 **Job Description**

Are you interested by video games and have a passion for this industry?

Join our award winning creation team and take part in creating user-interface assets and menu designs for our multiplatform games.

Your work will leverage the art direction, dress up the user-experience flow and enhance the visual narrative of the game.

Working under the supervision of the UI/UX Director you will be a key part of the art production, collaborating with the user-experience and design teams. You will be working alongside experts in various disciplines, ranging from engineering to design, art and UX.

Your work will take you on a technological, design and artistic journey across all gaming hardware platforms: from tablet and mobile to PC and home-consoles.

 **Qualifications**  

* Solid experience in composition, colour and production.
* Solid experience in typography.
* Solid expertise in Photoshop.
* Solid expertise in Illustrator.
* Solid expertise in photomontage and 2D special effects.
* Solid expertise in drawing and touching up using a graphics tablet.
* Able to produce original graphical compositions (framing, camera angles, etc.).
* Ability to take graphical initiative is desired and appreciated.
* Proactive and able to work independently.
* Able to work in a team.
* Very good general knowledge of visual and graphical trends (TV, movies, web, games, etc.).

Assets:

* Portfolio demonstrating your sense of artistry and finesse.
* Good personal experience desired.
* High level of English appreciated.
* Finesse and high quality of work are expected.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join the World of Gameloft?**

* Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
* Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
* Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
* Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
* Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!

**Benefits:**

* Learning bootcamps and platforms (such as O'Reilly and GDC Vault)
* Birthday day off + option to work a shortened schedule on three days.
* Flexible work-from-home remote model

title: Head of People
description:
Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,600 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts.

With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector.

We are looking for a **Head of People** who will own the **operational infrastructure** that lets Qualifyze **hire, pay, develop, and retain people effectively**: Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Performance Management, Payroll, Compensation & Benefits Administration, and Compliance. Reporting directly to the SVP of Finance, you are the backbone of the People function.

**You'll have end-to-end ownership.** Every area below is yours, from design through execution to results. You don't hand work off and step back. When something breaks, you fix it, then fix the process behind it

You'll **shape the team**, hire into new roles, and set the standards the People function runs on.

#### **Main responsibilities:**

* **Leading and developing a high-impact team:**
  + You'll lead a lean, pragmatic team across People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and Business Partnering, setting clear priorities and performance expectations while carrying your own operational workload.
  + You'll coach each team member through regular 1:1s, reviews, and growth plans, building a team that becomes a trusted advisor to managers and business leaders as the business scales, hiring into open roles, and putting shared processes in place so delivery stays consistent across every location.
* **Driving end-to-end hiring & Employer Branding initiatives:**
  + You’ll deliver the hiring plan across all entities, owning the full recruitment process from sourcing and interviews to hiring manager enablement and offer management, while strengthening our employer brand to attract the talent we need.
  + You bring a data-driven mindset, tracking and acting on metrics such as time-to-hire, pipeline health, and source effectiveness to set priorities.
* **Building scalable People Operations & HR Systems:**
  + Own and continuously improve Personio and end-to-end People Operations across our entities ensuring accurate, compliant, and scalable processes throughout the employee journey.
  + Oversee accurate and timely payroll across all entities and jurisdictions, in collaboration with Accounting and external partners, while managing benefits administration and vendor relationships.
  + Drive operational excellence through automation, self-service, and AI-enabled solutions that improve the employee and manager experience, focusing on outcomes rather than activity.
  + Ensure compliance with local labour laws, maintain employment policies, contracts, and the employee handbook, and handle employee relations cases in partnership with legal counsel.
* **Driving our rewards policy & high-impact performance:**
  + Own compensation reviews, promotions, compensation ranges, and progression frameworks, ensuring fair and consistent outcomes.
  + Maintain compliance with EU Pay Transparency requirements and related audits and reporting.
  + Lead the performance review cycle across all entities, including manager enablement, calibration, and consistent, well-documented outcomes.
  + Design and continuously improve performance frameworks, ensuring successful rollout and adoption.
* **Workforce Planning & Organisational Effectiveness:**
  + Partner directly with Finance to build and maintain workforce planning models, budget-to-actuals tracking, and headcount reporting.
  + Provide the data and process rigour needed to support organisational design and restructuring decisions.
* **Creating and Engaging Workplace & Culture:**
  + Ensure the smooth running of our offices in Frankfurt, New Jersey, Hyderabad, and Barcelona, creating environments that support productivity, community, and employee well-being.
  + Lead culture and key company initiatives, including global and local office events.

#### **Main requirements:**

* 7+ years in people, HR, or shared services roles, with direct, hands-on ownership of talent acquisition, performance management, payroll, HRIS, and compliance.
* Experience in high-change environments. Multi-country and multi-entity experience is a strong plus.
* Comfortable managing complexity across multiple jurisdictions. Practical experience with Spanish and/or German labor law is a strong plus.
* A track record of personally owning the operational execution of people processes at scale, and of managing teams across multiple locations.
* Tech-savvy with a mindset for adopting AI, automation, and process optimization.
* Fluent English is required. Spanish and/or German are a plus.
* An organized, structured thinker with a pragmatic approach to finding solutions in a fast-paced environment.

#### **Salary:**

At Qualifyze, our salary ranges are transparent internally, and we aim to follow a similar approach externally. For this role, we’re happy to share a reference point within the band: the expected salary range is around **80,000 - 85,000 €**, centred around the median.

Final compensation will depend on experience and performance during the process, with some flexibility within the range.

#### **What We Offer:**

* Competitive, annually reviewed compensation package
* Country vacation package that increases with your tenure
* ️ Country specific benefits offering incl.private health care, fitness and meal allowances
* Annual personal development budget to increase your impact
* Hybrid working mode, plus up to 3 months of the year work from anywhere.
* All the best kit and tools to work effectively
* Annual in person all company event and celebration in Europe
* Working with an exceptional team, doing some of the best work of your career

#### **Use of AI in Our Recruitment Process:**

We believe in a humanled hiring process. All applications are reviewed manually by our Talent Acquisition team, and neither Talent Acquisition nor Hiring Managers use AI to screen, filter, rank, assess, or make decisions about candidates, including during interviews and assessments. During interviews, AI may be used only to support note-taking and transcription. All hiring decisions are made by people!

#### **Diversity & Inclusion at Qualifyze:**

At Qualifyze, we value diversity and inclusion, recognizing the strength that complementary talents and perspectives bring to our team. Join us and help drive innovation, tackle challenges, and create meaningful change. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, disability, or age. Our hiring practices are rooted in fairness and respect, and we strive to create a culture where everyone feels valued and empowered.

title: Head of Paid Acquisition
description:
**About Click&Boat**
--------------------

Click&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling & renting boats easy.

Click&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals, with over €170M in annual GMV and a community of 2.4M+ registered users across 150+ countries worldwide. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the globe, from a day trip to a week-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.

To fuel our next phase of growth, we're hiring a Head of Paid Acquisition to own and scale our paid marketing strategy, based in our Barcelona office.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for a Head of Paid Acquisition to join our crew in Barcelona and own the strategy behind how we acquire renters and boat owners at scale, across all our markets.

Paid acquisition is a core growth lever for Click&Boat, sitting at the intersection of performance marketing, data, and brand. You'll lead a team of 3, own the paid media P&L, and work in close, day-to-day collaboration with Global Group Head of Performance (based in Miami) to align on global strategy, share learnings across the Group's marketplaces, and make the most of our combined scale.

Given the strategic weight of paid acquisition in our growth model, you'll report and present regularly to our Executive Board as well as to Boats Group stakeholders, on performance, strategy, and investment decisions.

**What floats your boat**
-------------------------

* Define and own the paid acquisition strategy (SEA, paid social, display/programmatic, app campaigns) across all markets, to hit revenue, contribution margin, and growth targets.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 3 Paid Acquisition Managers, setting clear objectives and building a culture of accountability, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Own the paid media budget and P&L: allocate spend by market and channel, and manage CAC/ROAS targets with rigor.
* Partner closely with Global Group Head of Performance to align on global media strategy, share best practices across the Group's marketplaces, and coordinate shared vendor relationships (Google, Meta, TikTok, etc.) where relevant.
* Report to the Executive Board and Boats Group stakeholders on performance and strategy, translating data into clear investment recommendations.
* Collaborate closely with Product, Tech, and Data teams on tracking, attribution, and landing page optimisation.
* Identify and test new channels and formats, and assess where AI can improve targeting, bidding, or creative performance.

**What you bring aboard**
-------------------------

* 7+ years of experience in paid acquisition / performance marketing, ideally in a B2C, marketplace, e-commerce, or travel environment.
* 3+ years of experience managing a team, driving performance through coaching, prioritisation, and clear goal-setting.
* Deep hands-on expertise across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and programmatic/display, ideally in multi-market, multi-language contexts.
* Data-obsessed and analytically rigorous: comfortable building and reading dashboards (Tableau or equivalent) and modeling CAC/LTV/ROAS.
* Comfortable operating in a matrixed, international organisation, collaborating with Group stakeholders across time zones.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present clearly and confidently to a Board / C-level audience.
* Full proficiency in English is required.

###### **Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Fluent in Spanish or French.
* Experience in the travel or marketplace industry.
* Experience working within a global group structure, balancing local execution with global alignment.

**The hiring journey**
----------------------

* HR call with our Head of Talent Acquisition
* Manager interview with our Head of Paid Acquisition (Group)
* Interview with our CTO
* Culture fit interview (VP People) / Validation interview (CEO)

We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

**What awaits you aboard**
--------------------------

* Real strategic scope: you own paid acquisition end-to-end, with visibility all the way to the Board.
* Exposure to a global Group: close, regular collaboration with Boats Group's team in Miami.
* 23 days of paid leave.
* 10 extra days off (CAB days).
* Restaurant tickets: €3.50 per worked day, 100% paid by CAB.
* Flexible retribution.
* Wellhub (sport & wellbeing discounts).
* Hybrid working arrangement: office Monday to Thursday, remote on Fridays.
* Boat licence
* Boat hire vouchers for friends & family, no commission when you're on board, 50% commission for your immediate family.
* Free bike parking, and discounted car parking with OCW.

Contract: Full-time, permanent.

Team: 3 direct reports.

**Ready to come aboard?**
-------------------------

If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit "apply to this job". At Click&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, strictly based on merit and regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We are committed to an inclusive process and will provide reasonable accommodations upon request during both selection and employment—because we hire for talent, drive, and mindset, and the sea is open to all.
